name: Aimtron Electronics Ltd.
summary: Aimtron Electronics Ltd. specializes in comprehensive Electronics System Design and Manufacturing (ESDM) services, delivering high-value, precision-engineered products. The company's capabilities extend from printed circuit board (PCB) design and assembly to the full-scale "Box Build" manufacturing of complex electronic systems. Serving a diverse clientele, Aimtron provides these solutions to manufacturers in India, the United States, Hong Kong, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Mexico. Its ESDM products and services are crucial for sectors such as industrial automation, electric vehicle mobility, IoT and embedded systems, medtech and wearables, gaming, and robotics. Established on April 19, 2011, Aimtron Electronics Ltd. is headquartered in Vadodara, India.
